title: Decompose dependency graph and introduce presubmit warmup + thin CI agent
author: Aisha Raman
release_notes: Refactors presubmit dependency graph into a modular catalog; adds lightweight presubmit warmup agent to reduce cold-start for lint/test jobs; no user-facing API changes.
description:
Summary: This PR breaks the monolithic CI dependency graph into a small, declarative catalog (tools/deps/catalog.yml) and implements a lightweight presubmit warmup agent that pre-fetches language runtimes and primes the toolcache on ephemeral runners.

Motivation: CI flakiness and long first-run latencies were traced to a large, tightly coupled dependency bootstrap path. Teams saw 20-40s variance on initial lint/test job starts and noisy network bursts when many jobs bootstrapped toolchains simultaneously. By decomposing the dependency topology and adding a thin warmup path, we reduce noise, make caching more explicit, and make future selective prefetch strategies possible.

Approach:
- Introduce tools/deps/catalog.yml: a small manifest that captures logical dep groups (node, python, go, docker) and their minimal bootstrap steps.
- Add ci/presubmit/warmup-agent: a tiny Go binary and systemd-style service that runs on ephemeral runners to pre-pull images, restore small tool caches, and perform quick validations of environment variables.
- Refactor CI workflows (ci/workflows/presubmit.yml) to call the warmup-agent when runner labels include warmup=true and to use the catalog when resolving which dep groups to prepare.
- Add a new fastpath lint shard (ci/workflows/lint-fastpath.yml) that only runs a subset of linters for quick feedback.

Changes (high level):
- added: tools/deps/catalog.yml (manifest format, schema v1)
- added: ci/presubmit/warmup-agent/main.go + Dockerfile + unit tests
- modified: ci/workflows/presubmit.yml (calls warmup step conditionally)
- added: ci/workflows/lint-fastpath.yml (fast lint lane)
- modified: scripts/toolcache/restore.sh (split restore into group-aware restore)
- modified: docs/ci/dep-management.md (explains catalog and migration)
- modified: Makefile and CI entrypoint to accept --dep-group flags

Commits (summary):
- 1a3e4d2: add catalog manifest and loader + schema tests
- 2b4f6a1: implement warmup-agent, Dockerfile and small unit tests
- 7c8d9ab: wire presubmit workflow to call warmup agent and add lint-fastpath
- 9f0b1c3: split toolcache restore by dep-group and add feature flag
- d4e5f6b: docs and release notes update

Review conversation (selected excerpts):
- Ethan Zhao (review): "Nice decomposition — can we keep the catalog schema intentionally tiny? worried about coupling later."
- Author (Aisha): "Agreed; kept schema to 3 top-level fields (id, groups, commands). I added schema tests to prevent creeping."
- Marina Kovacs (review): "Warmup agent LGTM; please add a conservative timeout so it never blocks the runner startup."
- Author: "Added 30s default timeout and a DEBUG env var to skip warmup for debugging."
- Liam O'Connor (approval): "Approach looks safe for canary; recommend rolling to fastpath first then broad rollout."
- Comment thread (post-merge): "Observed ~18% reduction in average presubmit wall clock for first-run jobs during canary window. Need to track network egress reduction metric."

CI status and checks:
- GitHub Actions: build matrix (linux/go, linux/python, docker image) — passed
- Unit tests: go test (warmup-agent) — passed
- Integration: smoke-presubmit (canary on redwood-examples) — passed
- Lint: go vet + staticcheck — passed
- E2E (nightly smoke): pending on merge but gated for next night

Merge outcome: merged via squash-merge into main on 2026-02-22 by Aisha Raman. Merge commit message kept a short changelog and referenced ENG-3142.

Notes for operators:
- To opt out for a runner set label warmup=false; default behavior remains unchanged for older runners.
- Tooling teams should update any ad-hoc scripts that call scripts/toolcache/restore.sh to pass --dep-group when invoking restore.
- Observability: dashboards updated (console -> CI presubmit latency) and a new metric ci.warmup.duration_ms emitted by warmup-agent.

Rollout plan:
1) Canary on redwood-examples (done)
2) Enable warmup only on fast feedback runners (next week)
3) Gradual expansion to additional pools with metric gating.

Known limitations and follow-ups:
- Warmup-agent currently restores a trimmed toolcache; a follow-up will add per-language heuristics (ENG-3201).
- Some longtail languages (ruby, dotnet) not included in v1 catalog; will be added after telemetry validates improvement.

Links:
- Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3142/decompose-ci-deps
- Docs: docs/ci/dep-management.md

If anything regresses we can flip the feature flag (CI_WARMUP_ENABLED=false) and revert via the usual hotfix flow.
